items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1960-09-16
items.q: I used to play up there with Kid René.

ctx.x: Your father never mentioned any either that you know of in his time that they had them? Never had them ever mentioned it. Yeah. Because I wondered if they had them out in the country and up in the other towns like Baton Rouge ever. Well sometimes they used to have the farming parade and different parades like that. Did he ever have bands come up there from New Orleans? I know sometimes they go up even now, the Eureka went up a couple years ago. Well we used to go up there, in my time we used to go up to New Roe…
Yeah. I used to play up there with Kid René. Oh yeah. You know him?
I knew him before he died. I didn't hear him at about one time is all I ever got to hear him. Kid René, I used to go up there and play with him, Kid René.

items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: I played with Kid René... I used to be with him for all the time.

ctx.x: So what did you do after that? I can't imagine what you did after that, I'm sure. And everything, where did you go? You must have played with some other bands.
I played with Kid René, Jobs. I played with George Augustin.
